prose: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the United States proposed an AI incident notification mechanism to China, and both sides agreed to set up an AI dialogue ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, the Financial Times reports. Bessent said the two sides are working towards a 'shared vision' after talks with his Chinese counterpart.
highlights: The US proposed an AI incident notification mechanism to China.
Both sides agreed to establish an AI dialogue ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.
Bessent described progress towards a 'shared vision' after talks with his counterpart.
